questions.stem: Which of the following is a natural acid?
questions.solution: Lemon juice is a natural acid because it contains citric acid, which occurs naturally in citrus fruits. Sulphuric acid, hydrochloric acid, and nitric acid are all strong acids that are typically produced through industrial processes and not found naturally in food. Therefore, lemon juice is the correct answer.

hi.solution: नींबू का रस एक प्राकृतिक अम्ल है क्योंकि इसमें सिट्रिक अम्ल होता है जो नारंगी फलों में प्राकृतिक रूप से पाया जाता है। सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल, हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल और नाइट्रिक अम्ल सभी मजबूत अम्ल हैं जो आमतौर पर औद्योगिक प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा बनाए जाते हैं और खाद्य पदार्थों में प्राकृतिक रूप से नहीं पाए जाते। इसलिए नींबू का रस सही उत्तर है।

questions.stem: Which of the following is a base?
questions.solution: Baking soda is a base because it can accept protons and has a pH greater than 7. Lemon juice, vinegar, and tamarind are acids, which means they release protons and have a pH less than 7. Therefore, the correct answer is baking soda.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक क्षार है?

questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of acids?
choices: React with metals to produce hydrogen gas

questions.stem: Which of the following indicators turns pink in a basic solution?
questions.solution: Phenolphthalein is a pH indicator that remains colorless in acidic solutions and turns pink in basic solutions. Methyl orange turns red in acidic conditions and yellow in basic, litmus paper turns blue in basic solutions but is not pink, and methyl red turns red in acidic conditions. Therefore, the correct answer is phenolphthalein.

questions.stem: If a solution turns methyl orange pink, what type of solution is it?
